description: Controlled vocabularies that OntologyTaggingArtifact and CurationArtifact draw on. This file is documentation + a machine-readable allowlist; the tagging schema only hard-enforces `esoteric_domains`. Other facets are validated softly (warnings) so the vocabulary can grow without breaking the build.

evidentiary_lanes.E: Primary (letters, interviews, contracts, manuscripts, period press)

content_classes.serious_scholarship: Peer-reviewed or rigorously argued historical/scholarly work.
content_classes.primary_source_discussion: Direct engagement with primary sources or manuscripts.
content_classes.scholarly_reliability_review: Assessment of how reliable a source or claim is.
content_classes.history_of_science: History-of-science framing of esoteric / scientific material.
content_classes.book_or_manuscript_history: Book history, editions, bibliography, manuscript studies.
content_classes.pop_occult_low_relevance: Pop-occult / lifestyle content with low scholarly value.
content_classes.generic_lifestyle: Lifestyle / wellness content unrelated to scholarship.
